parsing_traps.trap: Consolidated financials reported in SGD, portfolio in dual currency
parsing_traps.detail: CLCT's consolidated financial statements are presented in S$ (the reporting currency), NOT RMB. Underlying assets/income are RMB; Financial Highlights show both RMB and S$ for revenue/NPI. The Portfolio Statement (pp.100-102) prints both RMB'000 and S$'000 columns side-by-side for the SAME valuation. market_valuation captured in S$ (Tier C audited). Per-property NPI cards are in RMB million.

parsing_traps.trap: 'Net income' line on Statement of Total Return is a sub-total, not the year's result
parsing_traps.detail: p95 prints 'Net income' S$124,270k AFTER trust expenses/finance but BEFORE disposal loss, fair-value changes and tax. income_stmt_metrics.net_income = 'Total return for the year after taxation' = S$5,573k. Do not use the S$124,270k line.

Below-NPI income items correctly classified as adjustments in line_items: finance income (+1,487), realised FX gain (+2,055). Finance costs (60,076) is an expense; loss on disposal, FV changes, unrealised FX, taxation are SIGNED adjustments. NONE mislabelled as revenue. revenue = gross rental income + other income only (303,720).
Divested 31 Oct 2025; absent from 2025 Portfolio Statement (market_valuation=null, status=divested). Partial-year GR/NPI in totals. 2024 comparative RMB785,000k / S$145,618k.

parsing_traps.trap: Trade mix scoped within asset class but as % of total portfolio GRI
parsing_traps.detail: p31 lists trade sectors grouped under Retail (sum 69.3%), Business Parks (27.0%) and Logistics Parks (3.7%); each line is % of TOTAL portfolio GRI, so all 26 rows sum to ~100%.
